items.name: Rubik's German Nationals 2025
items.information:
Wir freuen uns darauf, euch bei der diesjährigen deutschen Meisterschaft im Speedcubing in Vellmar bei Kassel begrüßen zu dürfen!

We look forward to welcoming you to this year's German Speedcubing Championships in Vellmar near Kassel!

items.name: Plaza Río 2 Open 2025

venue.name: [Centro Comercial Plaza Río 2](https://www.plazario2.com/)
venue.details: Main Hall of the Shopping Center

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5OTMwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7c1d2d5b2b428f183b8eb19b4e35641cbc2fc757/Plaza%20R%C3%ADo%202%20Open%202025_v2.jpg)

Esta competición se celebra en un centro comercial y es posible que haya un nivel de ruido que no podamos controlar. Se recomienda leer la pestaña de [información importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaRio2Open2025#58113-informacion-importante-important-information).

Por limitaciones del espacio de competición el viernes, el registro para **5x5x5, 3x3x3 a ciegas y 3x3x3 a una mano** está limitado a los **30, 20 y 40** primeros en apuntarse a cada categoría respectivamente. Disculpen las molestias.

This competition will be hold in a shopping centre and it's likely that there's some noise that we can't control. It's recommended to read the [important information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaRio2Open2025#58113-informacion-importante-important-information) tab.

Due to limitations in the competition area on Friday, registration for **5x5x5, 3x3x3 Blindfolded and 3x3x3 One-Handed** is limited to the first **30, 20 and 40** to sign up for each event respectively. Sorry for the inconvenience.
